content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stock photos

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Paddle offer simplicity but rent you access to their infrastructure. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery—until they don’t. Stripe and PayPal power these systems, and their country restrictions become your restrictions. Sovereign commerce stacks, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, flip this model. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), order storage (Supabase), and file delivery (Cloudflare R2). Payments process via NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. The architecture is yours after deployment—no platform dependency. For stock photos, this means instant global reach without geographic or financial barriers. The tradeoff? You configure the stack once. The reward? Lifetime ownership and zero recurring fees.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms exclude Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and others because Stripe and PayPal exclude them. These processors cite regulatory risks or fraud rates, but the result is the same: creators in these regions cannot sell. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. By using cryptocurrency payments, they eliminate the need for centralized processors. NOWPayments verifies transactions on-chain automatically, firing delivery webhooks the moment payment confirms. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep fees under $0.10 per transaction. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing, ensuring your delivery system works flawlessly. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure built for regions Stripe locked out. If you’re selling stock photos from Nigeria, this architecture treats you like any other creator on earth.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus payment processor fees. Add currency conversion losses, and your margins shrink fast. Sovereign stacks cut these middlemen. NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is the only cost. Buyers pay you directly in crypto, and delivery triggers instantly. No chargebacks. No frozen accounts. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys in 48 hours, loading up to 5 products and configuring your email security. The $197 one-time fee covers lifetime ownership. Compare this to Gumroad’s $10/month Pro plan or Paddle’s 5% cut. For stock photos, where margins matter, sovereign infrastructure delivers higher profits per sale. Plus, buyers in crypto-familiar regions like Nigeria, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe already understand these payment methods—no education required.
Sovereign stacks replace rented platforms with owned infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data, product files, and payment history. They can suspend your account or change their terms overnight. Sovereign stacks give you full data ownership. Orders store in your Supabase database. Files deliver from your Cloudflare R2 bucket. Automation runs on your Cloudflare Workers backend. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30 days of support to ensure everything works, but after deployment, COREMERCH has no access. Your store operates independently. For stock photos, this means instant delivery of high-resolution files the moment payment confirms—no manual intervention required. The architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm. It works where rented platforms fail.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria selling stock photos, conventional platforms are not an option—they’re a dead end. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural alternative. The Edge Commerce Stack is built for creators in regions Stripe and PayPal exclude. It’s not the easiest path—you’ll configure your stack once—but it’s the only path that gives you lifetime ownership and global reach. If you’re selling low-margin digital products, the 0.5% payment fee and zero recurring costs maximize your profits. If you value infrastructure sovereignty over temporary convenience, this is your architecture. Deploy it once. Own it forever. Sell to anyone, anywhere.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30 days of support to ensure everything works. After deployment, the architecture is yours—no ongoing technical management required.
What if my buyers don’t use cryptocurrency?
Buyers in regions like Nigeria, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe are already familiar with crypto. For others, NOWPayments provides simple payment instructions at checkout.
How do I handle refunds?
Sovereign stacks give you full control. Issue refunds directly from your crypto wallet—no processor involvement. The system is designed for transparency.
Can I scale beyond 5 products?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a scaling playbook. Add more products to your Supabase database and update your Cloudflare Workers logic as needed.
